name: Haishin Kanojo
source:
Tomoki (screen name: "T-Mo") is a struggling, low-ranking streamer. He has a girlfriend, Kaho, who's devoted to him.

However, he currently has his eye on a popular gyaru streamer named "Ori-tya", and is trying to get close to her under the guise of talking about streaming equipment.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/14907]Novelgame[/url]]
